recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source fix is needed for FHIR-17567; any stale generated SVG tooltip or unrelated example typing concern should be handled under a separate tracker rather than this applied targetProfile wording issue.
issue_request: FHIR-17567 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OperationDefinition request to improve the poor OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile detailed description and address an example that appeared wrong because a Reference parameter had no targetProfile.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 7918c8dc0cfb27ce1ab1504e6cfa043771ab2695, matching Jira comment svn revision 14534, changed the OperationDefinition spreadsheet from the old Reference-only wording to optional Reference/canonical target wording and added the one-way opd-3 invariant. It did not change the example because the corrected rule does not require targetProfile for every Reference parameter.
additional_context: OperationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and normative from 4.0.0. Later targetProfile/opd-3 issues FHIR-17725, FHIR-26411, FHIR-39345, and FHIR-44690 refined the rule family by recognizing inline-resource profile use and correcting the invariant to the current all-resource-types expression. FHIR-48481 is related background for derived-operation targetProfile behavior but does not change the seed conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml removes the poor STU3 wording, keeps targetProfile optional, and constrains targetProfile only when present, so operationdefinition-example.xml remains valid without adding targetProfile values to its Reference parameters.

related_jiras.note: Published follow-up found the original post-17567 restriction too tight for profile-on-inline-resource use and led toward broader profile support.
Published R5 change made OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile also apply to inline resource parameters.
Published correction updated opd-3 to allow targetProfile on Reference, canonical, or resource parameter types.
Applied R6 correction changed opd-3 to use all-resource-types and requested definition clarification reflected in current source.
Applied derivation guidance discusses inherited targetProfiles but is not needed to decide the seed.
